title: Crypto Winter Night: a fourth map
description: An unlockable map where the screen goes dark between candle flashes, with a new Frost Miner enemy, a boss variant, its own music mood and a map pick for free runs.

title: Missions: goals that pay CLOUT
description: Goals per character and per map (Survive 10:00 as the Whale, kill Rug Lord without a hit) that pay CLOUT once, with progress on the title screen and a toast when one lands.

title: Market Eras: survive through crypto history
description: A new map whose ground and enemies change as you survive, from a genesis-block era to DeFi summer to altcoin season, each era ending in its own boss variant.
